'''David Packard''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Woods]] or, when combining [[Miskatonic Horror]] with [[Innsmouth Horror]], at the [[Marsh Refinery]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Fight]]
*+1 [[Sneak]]

Draw 1 [[Skill]] card when David Packard joins you.
